features.description: Roadmap-vs-plan authoring guidance. Update DontPanic authoring guidance so humans and agents can classify an ask as an implementation plan, tracking roadmap, investigation, operator setup task, or design/product specification. Include concrete decision rules, examples, and anti-patterns. The guidance must explain that roadmaps are tracking parents and child plans are dispatchable work. V0 documents investigation and design/product-spec distinctions as authoring guidance only; first-class schema enforcement waits for the roadmap's V3 plan_kind work.
steps: Update docs/AUTHORING_PLANS.md with a concise 'What should I create?' section near the top.
Add examples for one-plan implementation, roadmap with child plans, investigation, and operator setup.
Document the rule that future roadmap milestones need trigger conditions and should not be dispatched until unlocked.
Add a short release-impact prompt that plan authors answer before lock.
features.acceptance: (1) docs/AUTHORING_PLANS.md includes a roadmap-vs-plan decision table before the detailed examples. (2) The guidance covers plan, roadmap, investigation, operator setup, and design/product spec asks. (3) At least one example explicitly shows a roadmap parent with a child implementation plan. (4) The text says roadmaps track strategy; child plans ship code/docs. (5) The guidance names the release-impact prompt that F003 will formalize. (6) The guidance explicitly says V0 does not add schema-level plan_kind/investigation/design-spec enforcement. (7) Documentation remains ASCII and validates any embedded plan examples if they are marked as dontpanic-plan-example.

evidence_refs.note: F001 implementation summary; targeted examples test passed and full sweep reported 2608 passed, 7 skipped.
Auditor signed off F001 with no findings.
Authoring guidance now includes roadmap-vs-plan classification, roadmap/child examples, investigation and operator setup examples, release-impact prompt, and v0 schema-scope caveat.

features.description: Read-only parallel-readiness recommender. Add `dontpanic next` with text and JSON output. It scans active/draft/completed plan directories, feature `depends_on`, plan frontmatter `dependencies`, `requires_gates[]`/gate state where available, budget/breaker state where available, `requires_capabilities[]`, `external_refs[]`, and active supervisors. It outputs ready-to-dispatch features or child plans with explanations, plus not-ready reasons and precision-biased substrate-overlap warnings based on same plan/feature, intersecting allowed_paths, path-like step tokens, and active supervisor metadata. Fleet scope aggregates per-project repo analyses; it is not a scheduler.
steps: Add a small planning/readiness module that loads plan frontmatter and features.json without mutating files.
Compute feature readiness from feature depends_on and passes flags.
Compute plan readiness from frontmatter dependencies and parent/child relationships.
Read active supervisor state and warn when recommended work appears to overlap active work by same plan/feature or by intersecting allowed_paths plus path-like step tokens.
Read known gate, breaker, and budget state when available; mark work not-ready or warn when dispatch is likely to hit an existing pause condition.
Add `dontpanic next [--scope repo|fleet] [--max-parallel N] [--format text|json] [--include-not-ready]`.
Implement fleet mode as aggregation of per-project recommendations from the project registry; do not add cross-project scheduling.
For each recommendation, emit an exact candidate command or a reason no exact command can be formed.
Add tests for independent features, sequential features, blocked plan dependencies, active-supervisor overlap, budget/breaker warnings, fleet aggregation, malformed plan handling, and JSON shape.
Dogfood the command against the current DontPanic active plan inventory and save the JSON output as evidence.
features.acceptance: (1) `dontpanic next --format=json` returns schema_version, generated_at, scope, ready[], not_ready[], warnings[], and candidate_commands[]. (2) A fixture plan with F001/F002 independent features recommends both when max-parallel >=2. (3) A fixture plan with F002 depends_on F001 does not recommend F002 until F001 passes true. (4) A plan whose frontmatter dependencies point at an incomplete plan is not ready and explains the dependency. (5) Active-supervisor/path-overlap fixtures produce precision-biased advisory collision warnings without suppressing unrelated ready work. (6) Known gate/breaker/budget state surfaces as a warning or not-ready reason when available. (7) Fleet scope aggregates per-project recommendations and labels project identity; it does not claim cross-project scheduling. (8) Text output is human-readable and includes exact next commands. (9) The command never writes files. (10) Tests cover at least 10 readiness cases. (11) Evidence includes `dontpanic-next-real-inventory-output.json` generated against the current DontPanic plan inventory.

features.description: Release and documentation impact checklist. Add a root-level product changelog convention plus an advisory impact checker used primarily by `dontpanic next` and secondarily by plan-lock messaging when lock-time git diff is available. The checklist distinguishes internal implementation changes from public/user-facing changes and asks whether README, onboarding, architecture map, dashboard, capability manifests, CLI help, schemas, and changelog/release notes need updates. Draft-time advice uses plan intent (`surfaces`, `allowed_paths`, feature step path tokens); lock-time advice may use git diff for precision.
steps: Add or update root CHANGELOG.md for public/product-facing DontPanic changes, distinct from claude/shared/CHANGELOG.md.
Document when root CHANGELOG.md is required and when claude/shared/CHANGELOG.md is sufficient, using an explicit path/surface pattern table.
Add a release-impact checklist template to docs/AUTHORING_PLANS.md or a linked docs file.
Add a lightweight advisory checker or helper that maps draft-time plan intent and lock-time git diff (when available) to suggested docs/release updates; advisory only.
Ensure architecture/onboarding/dashboard/README/capability-manifest update prompts are visible in plan authoring guidance.
Add tests or golden-output fixtures for at least CLI/schema/dashboard/docs-only impact scenarios.
features.acceptance: (1) Root CHANGELOG.md exists and explains its relationship to claude/shared/CHANGELOG.md. (2) Authoring docs include a release-impact checklist covering README, onboarding/getting-started, architecture map, dashboard, capability manifests, CLI help, schemas, and public metadata/social preview. (3) A path/surface pattern table distinguishes root-CHANGELOG-required, shared-CHANGELOG-sufficient, and usually-no-changelog changes. (4) An advisory helper/checker maps representative changed paths and plan-intent signals to suggested update surfaces without blocking. (5) `dontpanic next` is the primary advisory output surface; plan-lock messaging is secondary when git diff is available; no v0 sidecar is required. (6) Tests or golden fixtures cover docs-only, schema, CLI, dashboard, capability-manifest, social-preview, and internal-only changes. (7) No secret values are read or written.
